purpose: Original KSEAB-style grammar practice; not copied PYQs.

questions.question: Complete the sentence with the correct noun form of 'decide': The committee made a final _____.
Fill in the blank with a suitable article: She is _____ honest student.
Fill in the blank with a suitable preposition: The train arrived _____ the station on time.
Use the correct form of the verb in brackets: The students _____ (prepare) for the examination now.
Add a suitable question tag: You have completed the assignment, _____.
Identify the infinitive in the sentence: Rohan went to the library to borrow a book.
Identify the part of speech of the underlined word: She spoke softly to the child. ('softly')
Identify the figure of speech: The moon smiled at us.
Add a suitable prefix to form the opposite of 'possible'.
Change into passive voice: The teacher praised the students for their work.
questions.answer: The students were praised by the teacher for their work.

questions.question: Change into reported speech: Meena said, 'I am preparing for my examination.'
questions.answer: Meena said that she was preparing for her examination.

questions.question: Frame a question so that the underlined phrase is the answer: Ravi travelled to Mysuru by bus. ('to Mysuru')
questions.answer: Where did Ravi travel by bus?

questions.question: Rewrite using the comparative degree: Very few cities in Karnataka are as large as Bengaluru.
questions.answer: Bengaluru is larger than most other cities in Karnataka.

questions.question: Rewrite using 'unless': If you do not revise regularly, you may forget the concepts.
questions.answer: Unless you revise regularly, you may forget the concepts.

questions.question: Combine the sentences using a suitable linker: He was tired. He completed the work.
questions.answer: Although he was tired, he completed the work.

questions.question: Complete the sentence using the correct conditional form: If I had known about the meeting, I _____ (attend) it.
Rewrite in the present continuous tense: She writes a letter to her friend.
questions.answer: She is writing a letter to her friend.

questions.question: Correct the error: Each of the students have submitted their project.
questions.answer: Each of the students has submitted their project.

questions.question: Fill in the blank: He has been living here _____ 2018.
Fill in the blank: We waited for _____ hour before the bus arrived.
